remark: LinkageError occurs if there is a problem during the linking phase, such as an incompatible class file or missing dependencies. ExceptionInInitializerError occurs if the static initializer of the class throws an exception or encounters an error. ClassNotFoundException occurs if the class with the given name cannot be found on the classpath. Since the code does not validate the class name or ensure the class is present and can be linked/initialized, all three exceptions can be triggered at runtime without any preventive measures.
